hero.title: WORK WITH SERIOUS
hero.subtitle: Horror gaming with real reactions and a chat that's in the room. Production handled in-house — site, edits, and all.

differentiator.title: THE ENGINEER BONUS
differentiator.body: I'm an Electrical Engineering student and full-stack engineer — I built this site. Your brand gets a creator who can actually build with and technically break down your product, not just read a script. Capture cards, peripherals, software, dev kits: I'll play it AND publish a real technical writeup.

packages.name: STREAM MENTION
packages.deliverable: Verbal mention + on-screen brand placement during a 2-3 hour livestream on YouTube + Twitch. Link drops in chat and bio for 7 days.

packages.name: INTEGRATED VIDEO SEGMENT
packages.deliverable: 60-90 second integrated segment inside an edited horror gameplay video. Custom written, brand-aligned, no script-read energy.

packages.name: REVIEW + TECHNICAL BREAKDOWN
packages.deliverable: Full dedicated review video plus an accompanying technical writeup on camry.dev. Built for tech and gaming brands who want depth.

packages.name: CUSTOM
packages.deliverable: Multi-stream campaigns, series sponsorships, product gifting, affiliate deals. Email and we'll build it.
